title: Create: Special Recipes
description: The addon adds recipes for farm automation.
body:
More recipes will be added here in future versions.

List of recipes added by the mod
- Recipe tuff from diorite and andesite.
- Diamond recipe from a block of coal and lava.
- Recipe coal from 4 charcoal
- Netherrack recipe from cobblestone and Nether Wart or from 9 cobblestone and a block of Nether Wart
- Netherite Scrap recipe from Netherrack, gold ingot and lava
- Emerald recipe made from diamond, quartz, and green dye
